entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Finally. Get me someone who can actually do something.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand Pulse. I'm done with it. It's ridiculous.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

It's a 'this thing is impossible' matter! The interface is so confusing, and the whole device is just plain hard to use. I read the user manual front to back and it's useless! Honestly, I expected more from a company like VeloFit. This is a premium price for a frustrating experience.

I understand your frustration. The interface can take a little getting used to. For instance, to access the detailed heart rate chart, are you swiping up from the main clock face or are you tapping the screen first?

I'm not doing a tutorial with you! I've been tapping and swiping for over a week. I want my money back. This is not what was advertised. Get me your manager right now, or I swear I'm going to post a review on every single website about this.
I understand you're upset, and there's no need for a manager. I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up your order to check the return eligibility. Can I have your order number please?
Fine. It's VF88602. You guys have twelve days to fix this, or you're getting it back.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered on January 7th, so about 12 days ago. Let me just check our policy...
Alright, I've confirmed it. Not a problem at all. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for a full refund.

Yes, absolutely. We want to make sure our customers are completely satisfied. I am processing the return authorization right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Oh. Well... that's much better than I expected. That was... actually very easy. Thank you, Sarah.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you today. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
